g.text: Pi-Gen imaging: post-boot Ansible convergence on the head (dalmasca)
asserts: node.conf has NODE_ROLE, hostname -s = inventory name,
munge active + key 0400 munge:munge, slurm.conf present,
clock drift < 300 s. sysctl bridge-nf-call-iptables + ip_forward.
assert 5 hostnames, k3s nodes Ready (if enabled)
FINDING (likely blockers, verify on the head):
1. Workers are reached as ivalice with become=sudo and become_ask_pass=False,
but config.base does not set PASSWORDLESS_SUDO=1 (pi-gen default 0), so
every privileged task on a worker should fail on the sudo password prompt.
2. ansible.cfg sets stdout_callback = yaml, which lives in community.general,
and common/tasks uses ansible.posix.sysctl. Debian ansible-core ships neither
collection, and an unresolvable module fails at parse time, which
FINDING: the wait quorum is 3 of 5, but 90-verify hard-requires all 5 workers
idle/mix/alloc and srun -N5 to succeed (20-slurm-controller only counts
configured nodes, which sinfo lists even when down). With 1-2 workers down the
service burns its 5 restarts in 30 min and stops. Align quorum and verify bar.
